messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=billing-metering-aggregator severity=high. Some customers reporting 0 usage showing in dashboard; invoices delayed. See /incidents/billing-visibility for runbook.
Priya Singh: noticed customer-reports channel has 6 threads in the last 10m. dashboards show last successful aggregation at 2026-03-15T01:03Z. circling for oncall.
Marcus Chen: I'm oncall. I can take first triage. quick checks: 1) aggregator logs 2) reconcile job status 3) DB write lag. Will post short checklist.
Marcus Chen: running: `kubectl -n billing logs deploy/metering-agg --since=15m | tail -n 200` got repeated timeouts to upstream-rate-limiter and a few 502s from usage-ingester.
Marcus Chen: reconcile job `billing-reconcile` shows stuck at step "merge-usage" for 36m. kube pods OOM? Pod metering-agg-3 restarted 2x in last hour.
Tom W: adding context — earlier today we bumped rate-limit thresholds for internal ingestion during canary; maybe related.
Marcus Chen: rolling back the rate-limit tweak on the ingestion proxy now (`helm upgrade --reuse-values --set proxy.rateLimit=null ingestion-proxy`). ETA ~3m.
Lisa Ortiz: prepping customer-facing status page update. Draft: "We are investigating an issue affecting billing and dashboard usage visibility for a subset of customers. Impact: usage may display as 0 or be delayed; invoices may be delayed. We are actively working on a fix and will provide updates every 30 minutes." ok to post?
Eve (CS): please include request for customers to not open duplicate tickets — provide link to incident status page and our support queue. Also we should give an estimated window if we have one.
Marcus Chen: rollback complete; ingestion proxy pods stable. I still see backlog in `usage-queue` (SQS-like queue) of ~1.2M messages. Drain rate improving from 270/s to 980/s.
Priya Singh: action items: A) continue drain monitoring B) kick off on-demand reconcile for affected window C) prepare invoice reconciliation notes for CS. Marcus, can you schedule the reconcile run?
Marcus Chen: yes starting `billing-reconcile --start 2026-03-15T00:00Z --end 2026-03-15T02:00Z --priority high` now. Logs: `JOB STARTED (id=rec-20260315-01)`.
Raj Patel (Billing Eng): tagging in — we'll watch the reconcile. If reconcile completes successfully, we should have backfilled dashboards and invoice generation can resume. If not, plan B is to run a manual aggregation script per-customer.
Tom W: customer impact estimate? how many customers affected and severity?
Marcus Chen: preliminary: ~0.8% of active customers (mainly high-throughput customers in us-west). Some show 0 usage on dashboard; backend usage is present in raw queue but not yet merged. So money is not lost, just delayed.
Eve (CS): drafting customer email template: "We’re currently investigating an issue causing temporary billing and dashboard delays. If your invoice is expected in the next 24 hours, it may be delayed. No customer charges will be missed; we will follow up with a reconciliation statement once processing completes." Thoughts?
Lisa Ortiz: customer-facing blurb for status page v1:
```
Incident: Billing visibility outage
Impact: Some customers may see 0 usage or delayed usage in dashboards; invoice generation delayed for a subset of accounts.
Status: Investigating
Next update: in 30 minutes
```
+ include link to support and estimated ETA when reconcile finishes.
Priya Singh: CS note for internal teams (short): "Do not promise refunds or credits yet; wait for final reconciliation. Share high-priority customer list to billing-eng@redwood for manual backfill if needed."
Marcus Chen: reconcile job progress: 45% complete (processing items at 1.1k/s). No errors so far. I see some timeouts to external metering storage at 01:17Z but retries succeeding.
Lisa Ortiz: posted initial status page update and pinned in #customers-incidents. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1765212345
Eve (CS): sending initial customer notification to impacted accounts now (batch 1). Will CC billing-eng for any direct escalations. Template used (short):
"Hi — we’re investigating an issue that may delay billing visibility. We’re actively processing backfill and will follow up once complete. No action required from you. — Redwood Support"
Marcus Chen: reconcile finished at 1765212740. Job rec-20260315-01 completed, merged ~1.15M usage events, no data loss. Running post-merge sanity checks (`SELECT count(*) FROM usage_merged WHERE ts >= '2026-03-15T00:00Z'`) shows expected counts.
Raj Patel (Billing Eng): confirming invoice generation can resume. I triggered the invoice-run for affected batch: `billing-invoice --window 2026-03-15T00:00Z/2026-03-15T02:00Z --batch affected-1`. Monitor for failures.
Tom W: quick customer impact assessment: number impacted ~850 customers, majority low-dollar; 12 enterprise customers saw delayed dashboards but invoices will reflect correct usage after backfill. Recommend proactive notification to those 12.
Eve (CS): noted — sending personalized notifications to the 12 and offering reconcilation reports.
Priya Singh: handoff in 15m to overnight oncall. Marcus, please post a short summary for the next oncall with runbook pointers and current status.
Marcus Chen: handoff summary:
- Incident start: 1765212345 (2026-03-15T01:05Z)
- Symptom: consumption shows 0 for subset due to ingestion rate-limit change + backlog; aggregator restarted twice; reconcile needed
- Mitigation taken: rolled back ingestion rate-limit tweak; started high-priority reconcile; drained ~1.15M messages; invoice-run kicked off successfully
- Current status: invoice-run in progress for affected batch; dashboards will be repopulated as merges complete; CS batch notifications sent; status page updated
- Followups: monitor invoice-run logs, verify customer dashboards for the 12 enterprise customers after run completes, prepare reconciliation statements for any customers requesting them
- Links: status page https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1765212345, runbook /incidents/billing-visibility, logs link https://logs.redwood.ai/query?id=rec-20260315-01
Marcus Chen: handing off to Tom W at 1765212945. Tom, please escalate to Raj if you see invoice-run failures.
Tom W: acknowledged. I'll own overnight and post if anything changes. Thanks Marcus and team. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident P2 billing-visibility outage transitioned to monitoring. Next automated update in 30m or on state change.
